### Single Cell Seurat Data Analysis
## Load Necessary Packages
```{r import, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(reshape2)
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(Matrix)
library(MatrixGenerics)
library(edgeR)
library(mltools)
library(pheatmap)
library(data.table)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratData)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(DropletUtils)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
```
                      
## Check Working Directory
```{r Working Directory}
print(getwd())
```

## Load the data
```{r load_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# List of .h5 files and sample names
h5_files <- c("./data/Raw_Features/3a_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/3b_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/4a_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/4b_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/5a_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/5b_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/7a_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
             "./data/Raw_Features/7b_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
sample_names <- c("Sample3a", "Sample3b", "Sample4a", "Sample4b", "Sample5a", "Sample5b", "Sample7a", "Sample7b")

# Create a list to store individual Seurat objects
seurat_list <- list()

# Loop through files and create Seurat objects
for (i in seq_along(h5_files)) {
  # Read the H5 matrix
  counts <- Read10X_h5(h5_files[i])
  
  # Create Seurat object with sample tag
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = sample_names[i])
  
  # Add sample ID to metadata and to barcode names
  seu$sample <- sample_names[i]
  colnames(seu) <- paste(sample_names[i], colnames(seu), sep = "_")

  # Store in list
  seurat_list[[i]] <- seu
}

# Merge all Seurat objects into one
combined_seurat <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], 
                         y = seurat_list[-1], 
                         add.cell.ids = sample_names)

```

## Generate Rank Plots for each sample
```{r, rank plots}

# Loop through each sample and plot
for (i in seq_along(h5_files)) {
  # Read raw matrix (not filtered)
  raw_counts <- Read10X_h5(h5_files[i])
  
  # Run DropletUtils barcodeRanks
  br <- barcodeRanks(raw_counts)
  
  # Extract data
  df <- data.frame(rank = br$rank, total = br$total)
  
  # Remove NA values
  df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]
  
  # Log-log plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rank, y = total)) +
    geom_line(color = "blue") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(title = paste0("Barcode Rank Plot: ", sample_names[i]),
         x = "Barcode Rank",
         y = "Total UMI Counts") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = metadata(br)$knee, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = metadata(br)$inflection, color = "green", linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p)
}

```

## Sample QC Metrics Visualization
```{r, sample QC Visualization}

# Add QC metric to combined Seurat object
combined_seurat$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(combined_seurat$nFeature_RNA) / log10(combined_seurat$nCount_RNA)

# Extract metadata
metadata <- combined_seurat@meta.data
metadata$cells <- rownames(metadata)

# Rename columns for consistency
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::rename(seq_folder = orig.ident,
                nUMI = nCount_RNA,
                nGene = nFeature_RNA)

# UMI Distribution
ggplot(metadata, aes(color = sample, x = nUMI, fill = sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Cell density") +
  ggtitle("UMI Count Distribution per Sample") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 90, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 400, linetype = "dashed")

# Gene Distribution
ggplot(metadata, aes(color = sample, x = nGene, fill = sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Gene Count Distribution per Sample") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 6, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed")

# Boxplot of log10(nGene)
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = sample, y = log10(nGene), fill = sample)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Genes per Cell (log10 scaled)")

# Correlation nUMI vs nGene by Sample
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = nUMI, y = nGene)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = sample), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.5) + 
  stat_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 250, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~sample)

# Correlation nUMI vs nGene by Sample no facet
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = nUMI, y = nGene, color = sample)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.5) + 
  stat_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 500, linetype = "dashed") +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 250, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggtitle("nUMI vs nGene Across All Samples (Overlayed)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

#log10GenesPerUMI Complexity (Density)
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = log10GenesPerUMI, color = sample, fill = sample)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggtitle("Gene Complexity per Sample")

# Histogram per Sample (split by facet)
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = log10GenesPerUMI, fill = sample)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.02, color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~sample, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.8, NA)) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of log10(Genes) / log10(UMIs)", x = "log10(Genes) / log10(UMIs)", y = "Cell Count")

# Violin plot of log10(nGene)
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = sample, y = log10(nGene), fill = sample)) + 
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  ) +
  ggtitle("Genes per Cell (log10 scaled)") +
  ylab("log10(nGene)")

```

```{r, 5b removal}
# sample table before removal
table(combined_seurat$sample)

# sample table after removal
table(combined_seurat_no5b$sample)

seurat_list[[6]] <- NULL

sample_names <- c("Sample3a", "Sample3b", "Sample4a", "Sample4b", "Sample5a", "Sample7a", "Sample7b")

```

## Use EmptyDrops to filter samples
```{r, emptydrops loop}

# ── 0. Pre‑define things
library(DropletUtils)   # for emptyDrops
pval_cutoff <- 0.01
set.seed(123)

# Assume seurat_list and sample_names are exactly as you created them:
#   seurat_list[[i]] has project = sample_names[i],
#   and the counts live in the default "RNA" assay, slot = "counts"

# ── 1. Filter each Seurat object in the list ─────────────────────────────────
filtered_seurat_list <- vector("list", length(seurat_list))
names(filtered_seurat_list) <- sample_names

for (i in seq_along(seurat_list)) {
  sample_id <- sample_names[i]
  seu       <- seurat_list[[i]]
  
  # pull raw counts matrix
  counts_mat <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  cat("→ Processing sample:", sample_id, "(", ncol(counts_mat), "barcodes )\n")
  
  # run EmptyDrops
  edr <- emptyDrops(
    counts_mat,
    lower = 8
  )
  
  # pick barcodes with PValue <= cutoff (dropping NAs)
  keep <- rownames(edr)[!is.na(edr$PValue) & edr$PValue <= pval_cutoff]
  cat("   Retained", length(keep), "of", ncol(counts_mat), "barcodes\n\n")
  
  # subset the Seurat object to those barcodes
  filtered_seu <- subset(seu, cells = keep)
  
  # store back
  filtered_seurat_list[[sample_id]] <- filtered_seu
}

# ── 2. (Optionally) merge your filtered list into one object ──────────────────
combined_filtered <- merge(
  filtered_seurat_list[[1]],
  y           = filtered_seurat_list[-1],
  add.cell.ids = sample_names
)

```

## Filter out low nCount barcodes
```{r, filter low umi counts}

# Filter out cells with total UMI < 12
combined_filtered_lowUMI <- subset(combined_filtered, subset = nCount_RNA >= 12)

```

```{r, integrate data}
# make object name more concise
cflu_SCT <- combined_filtered_lowUMI
cflu_Norm <- combined_filtered_lowUMI
# perform SCTransform normalization
cflu_SCT <- SCTransform(object = cflu_SCT) %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca") %>%
  FindClusters(cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters") %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")


# perform normalizedata normalization
cflu_Norm <- NormalizeData(object = cflu_Norm)
cflu_Norm <- FindVariableFeatures(object = cflu_Norm)
cflu_Norm <- ScaleData(object = cflu_Norm)
cflu_Norm <- RunPCA(object = cflu_Norm)
cflu_Norm <- FindNeighbors(object = cflu_Norm, dims = 1:30)
cflu_Norm <- FindClusters(object = cflu_Norm, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
cflu_Norm <- RunUMAP(object = cflu_Norm, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")


DimPlot(cflu_SCT, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = c("sample"))
DimPlot(cflu_SCT, reduction = "umap.unintegrated")
DimPlot(cflu_Norm, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = c("sample"))
DimPlot(cflu_Norm, reduction = "umap.unintegrated")


# Integrate layers
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)
cflu_SCT <- IntegrateLayers(object = cflu_SCT, method = RPCAIntegration, normalization.method = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)

#UMAP of Integrated Data
DimPlot(
  cflu_SCT,
  reduction = "integrated.dr",
  group.by = c("sample"),
  combine = FALSE, label.size = 2
)
DimPlot(
  cflu_SCT,
  reduction = "umap.unintegrated",
  group.by = c("sample"),
  combine = FALSE, label.size = 2
)
DimPlot(
  cflu_SCT,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = c("sample"),
  combine = FALSE, label.size = 2
)

```
